DISTRICT & SHARED-SOURCE CONTEXT
Scope: All Districts. Each monitored water point is shown independently; an abnormal reading affects only that water point. No shared-source or contamination-propagation links are asserted. District filters (Kathmandu, Bhaktapur, Bidur/Nuwakot) and separate source/branch status need confirmed district and source IDs in the project data, so they are documented as a future enhancement rather than invented here.
Click a map marker to inspect a water point.
